content.comment_body: I am trying to transfer a PLC project using an SD card. When saving the .bin file, it only succeeds if I select Tools/Select HW/Type: HW version [article_no].Standard. The device I own is [article_no], but [article_no].Standard is disabled. If I select it anyway, I get an error: 'B001 H-Meter [Hours Counter]: Not supported.' Does anyone know how to proceed in this situation?

It seems you do not have a [article_no]. The [article_no] is a [product_name] from 1996. You probably own a [product_name] with article number like [article_no], which corresponds to [product_name] [version_no]. In the hardware selection, you should choose [product_name] [version_no].

analysis.insight_summary: Users report trouble selecting the correct hardware version when saving configuration files to SD cards, largely due to unclear device version naming and inactive selection choices in the software interface. Errors regarding unsupported functions complicate understanding of compatibility between hardware models and software options.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate a clear and easy process to locate and choose their specific hardware version in the software, ensuring their PLC project can be saved to the SD card without error or confusion about device compatibility.
